consequence.statement: Go code importing crossplane or crossplane-runtime must update the go.mod module path and all import statements to the v2 module path when moving to v2+.
consequence.remediation: Update go.mod and all imports to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 and github.com/crossplane/crossplane-runtime/v2.

original.statement: The Go module path changed to github.com/crossplane/crossplane/v2 (and crossplane-runtime/v2); Go consumers must update go.mod and all import statements.

decision.reason: [ev-d241daaf3863] lists this under breaking changes and says Go consumers who import crossplane or crossplane-runtime "will also need to update the module path" when they move to v2+, and that "all import statements in your code base need to be updated". That is a mandatory operator step, so migration-required fits. The proposed statement, remediation and medium severity match the evidence's own terms and limit the step to Go code that imports these modules when it moves to v2+.
